_about: Redferne's Residence, the sky-house of Naris at the top of the great chain (levels 12-28): a butler and a cook, rats in the larder, the Cleaver in its pen (a sub-boss), and Redferne himself, a wizard who tears rifts in the air and summons imps to his side.

79000.name: redferne wizard
79000.long_desc: Redferne the Wizard stands by his bed, turning an artifact over in his long fingers.
79000.description: A tall, gaunt wizard in a robe of midnight blue stitched with silver runes, his beard braided with copper wire. He hung his house from the sky on a chain, and he does not like visitors.

phases.message: Redferne's eyes blaze: "Enough! I will unmake you!"

abilities.name: Arcane Storm
abilities.telegraph: Redferne spreads his hands, and the air crackles with raw magic!

abilities.name: Lightning Lance
abilities.telegraph: Redferne points a crackling finger at you!

abilities.name: Unmaking
abilities.telegraph: Redferne begins to weave a spell of unmaking!

79001.name: imp summoned
79001.long_desc: A summoned imp cackles and flaps about the room.
79001.description: A red, bat-winged imp with a barbed tail, bound to Redferne's service.

79002.name: butler
79002.long_desc: The butler stands stiffly by the door, a silver tray in hand.
79002.description: Impeccably dressed and utterly unflappable; he has served the house for forty years and seen worse than you.

79003.name: cook
79003.long_desc: The cook bustles about the kitchen, muttering at the stew.
79003.description: A round woman in a floury apron with a ladle like a mace.

791079.name: homunculus conjured servant
791079.long_desc: A conjured homunculus scuttles along the floor, muttering to itself.
791079.description: A knee-high thing of clay and wax with a wizard's sigil burned into its brow. Redferne made dozens to keep his house, and they guard it jealously.
791079.why: the zone's regulars (tools/audit/densify.py fills its empty rooms with them): it had no ordinary foe of its own

mechanics.label: Arcane Rift
mechanics.why: rifts torn in the floor: step out

mechanics.shout: Redferne snaps his fingers, and imps pop into being around him!

_fill_no_mob: Every room of Redferne's house is no_mob (nothing wanders in or out): its homunculi are placed in the rooms and stay there
_fill: tools/audit/densify.py: 5 more of the zone's own ordinary creatures in its empty rooms, 0.45 hostile per walkable room as the aim
